connector.name: Tiger MCP
connector.registryDescription: Provides programmatic access to Tiger Cloud services, databases, and documentation.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image tiger-cli:0.21.2. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the timescale account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
